behavior: Each wallet transaction carries its USD value and classification (invoice payment with invoice and client, own transfer, sent, or unclassified until labelled), with a label route and a full CSV export
acceptance: GET /v1/profiles/{id}/transactions items add usdValue (1 USD per USD stablecoin), classification, labelable and invoice {invoiceId, number, clientName} or null.

Money in from one of the profile's invoice receive addresses (any option, mapped to the main invoice) is invoice; money between the user's profiles is own_transfer both ways; other money out is sent; other money in is unclassified or its label; another user's wallet or another profile's invoice is not matched.

PUT /v1/profiles/{id}/transactions/{chainId}/{txHash}/{logIndex}/label sets income, own_transfer, refund or other, and null clears it; an invoice payment, an automatic own transfer or money out is 409 not_labelable; a transaction the profile doesn't have, or a chain or log index past bigint, is 404; another user 403.

GET /v1/profiles/{id}/transactions.csv?from=&to= returns every transaction in those UTC days, newest first, with amount, USD value, classification, invoice number and client columns, formula cells guarded; bad dates are 422.
R-108, api.md, architecture.md (transfer_labels) and openapi.yaml describe it; the new routes are in the 403 test.
notes:
2026-10-18 review fail by subagent: Blockers:
1. apps/backend/internal/httpapi/moneyapi/model.go:71 and internal/activity/records.go:44. A transfer the user labelled own_transfer reads exactly like an automatic own transfer. The web (F241) cannot tell which rows take a label, so a wrong own_transfer label cannot be changed or cleared from the UI. Fix: add label (string|null) or labelable (bool) to the item, in openapi.yaml, api.md and R-108, with a test.
2. internal/activity/records_test.go. The privacy and matching filters have no test. Removing op.user_id = p.user_id (own-transfer EXISTS) or m.profile_id = p.id (invoice LATERAL) in transfers.go fails nothing. The option row to main invoice mapping (coalesce(main_id, id)) is not tested either. Fix: add three table rows: money in from another user's profile wallet is unclassified; money in from another profile's invoice receive address is unclassified with invoice null; money in from an option row's receive address is invoice with the main row's id, number and client.
3. docs/backend/architecture.md:164. The data model lists every table but not the new transfer_labels (key, label values, money in only). Add one bullet.
Minor:
- moneyapi/activity.go:157,162: ParseUint(...,64) accepts values above 2^63-1; pgx then fails to encode int8 and the route answers 500, not 404. Use bitSize 63.
- moneyapi/activity.go:111: the Amount column uses usdValue(t). Same digits today, but wrong once a non-USD token exists. Format the token amount separately. usdValue is the D-82 rule; it belongs in activity beside Classification, not in the HTTP model.
- transfers.go:70 and openapi.yaml:1625: invoices.number is NOT NULL, so the nil branch and the nullable number are dead.
- Acceptance 4 says streams; AllTransfers loads all rows into memory. Fine at freelancer scale and it frees the DB connection before the 30 s write. Fix the wording, or stream when merchant volume arrives (PLAN 11.7).
- openapi.yaml:887 says to is absent for today; the code has no upper bound.
- api.md:363 and :371 each hold two facts in one bullet (D-84).
- A reorg that changes log_index orphans a label; acceptable. A re-mined tx with shifted logs can move a label to a sibling log of the same tx; rare.
Checked and correct: InvoiceReceiver.settle() transfers from the receiver clone, and the watcher stores from as the counterparty for money in, both lowercase. A payer who pays the wallet directly is unclassified and can be labelled. The lookups are indexed: UNIQUE(chain_id, receive_address), UNIQUE(chain_family, address), the profiles PK and the labels PK. A wallet address belongs to one profile, so an own transfer cannot match across users. The 404, 409 and 403 cases behave as specified. The formula guard covers = + - @ tab CR on every cell; client name is the only typed cell. Go tests for activity, httpapi and database pass.
Web for F241: the zod schema adds usdValue (usdAmount), classification (openEnum of the 7 values, from a constant), invoice {invoiceId: hash32, number: count, clientName: nullable} or null, and the label field from blocker 1. Add a PUT label mutation that invalidates the list. Replace the client-side transactionsCsv, which exports at most 100 shown rows, with a fetch of transactions.csv that sends the bearer token and saves a blob, with from and to day inputs. Add copy for not_labelable and transaction_not_found.
